action.new_text:
"""Return an ordered keep mask and one finite margin per proposed call."""
    # Validate inputs
    if not isinstance(logp_with_result, np.ndarray) or not isinstance(logp_call_only, np.ndarray) or not isinstance(logp_no_call, np.ndarray):
        raise ValueError("Inputs must be numpy arrays.")
    if logp_with_result.ndim != 2 or logp_call_only.ndim != 2 or logp_no_call.ndim != 2:
        raise ValueError("Input matrices must be 2-dimensional.")
    if logp_with_result.shape != logp_call_only.shape or logp_with_result.shape != logp_no_call.shape:
        raise ValueError("Input matrices must have the same shape.")
    if logp_with_result.size == 0:
        raise ValueError("Input matrices must not be empty.")
    if np.any(logp_with_result > 0) or np.any(logp_call_only > 0) or np.any(logp_no_call > 0):
        raise ValueError("Log probabilities must be nonpositive.")
    if not np.all(np.isfinite(logp_with_result)) or not np.all(np.isfinite(logp_call_only)) or not np.all(np.isfinite(logp_no_call)):
        raise ValueError("Input matrices must contain finite values.")
    if not isinstance(tau_filter, (int, float)) or isinstance(tau_filter, bool):
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be a finite nonnegative numeric value.")
    if not np.isfinite(tau_filter) or tau_filter < 0:
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be finite and nonnegative.")

    n_candidates, horizon = logp_with_result.shape

    # Compute normalized weights
    t = np.arange(horizon)
    raw_weights = np.maximum(0, 1 - 0.2 * t)
    norm_weights = raw_weights / raw_weights.sum()

    # Compute losses per candidate
    loss_plus = -np.dot(logp_with_result, norm_weights)
    loss_call_only = -np.dot(logp_call_only, norm_weights)
    loss_no_call = -np.dot(logp_no_call, norm_weights)

    # Compute L_minus and margins
    L_minus = np.minimum(loss_no_call, loss_call_only)
    margins = L_minus - loss_plus

    # Determine keep
    keep = margins >= tau_filter

    return keep, margins
